name: dobe_hd_eject_end2
desc: looking back over his shoulder, his face stays the same the whole time: calm half-lidded narrow eyes, mouth closed in a slight smirk, no tongue. The rest of the thick goo lump keeps slowly squeezing out until it is completely out, the coiled mound on the floor grows bigger and heavier, then the last sticky strand stretches thin and snaps, and he rises up out of the squat to stand with the big coiled goo mound sitting separate on the floor between his feet. No tail
subject: muscular pink and yellow marbled goo doberman man, no tail
